x: Then came Hines, Weatherill, Penny fifth, Carter sixth, Cohen seventh, Ring thirteenth, and Wood seventeenth. This scoring enabled us to win comfortably from Surrey A.C., thus making our tenth win in the last twelve years.

Trevor Hart hands over to Charlie Walker with Weatherill (Portsmouth) waiting to take over from the fast-finishing Tulloh. Hugh Barrow will certainly not forget his first road relay in Belgrave colours.
